lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: Commander,

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: have you ever heard of lethargy?
I've heard of it.

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: Right.

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: I think I've contracted that disease.

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: I don't feel like doing anything today.

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: Nothing can get me off the couch.

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: I'm not even sure why I'm selected for this mission anyway.

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: Sigh...
How about playing games?

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: I just completed some daily quests,

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: and it feels more like a chore

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: than anything.

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: Even breathing seems cumbersome.

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: Am I going through puberty all of sudden?
Have you had a lot of work to do recently?

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: Work?

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: More than ever!

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: I can't even remember what I have done!
This is a classic sign of a burnout.

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: Wow, I never thought

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: I'd get burnt out from overexerting myself.
You should take a break from work.

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: I'd like to, but I'm not sure if my boss will agree.
I'll talk to her.

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: My heart... it's beating so fast!

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: I don't know if it's the excitement of being able to take a break

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: or because of you.

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: Either way, I feel much more energetic now.

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: Thanks.
Just take it easy.

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: Yes!
